title: Keep streamed TextDecoder state scoped to one ACP connection
body: A module-global TextDecoder used with decode(..., { stream: true }) retains partial-byte state. Concurrent ACP sessions can interleave that state and corrupt outbound JSON-RPC containing multibyte text.
resolution: Construct the TextDecoder inside startAcp so each connection owns its decoder. TextEncoder remains safe to share because encoding is stateless.

title: Treat session/load notifications as an authoritative transcript replay
body: ACP session/load streams the complete conversation through session/update notifications. Keeping the persisted transcript duplicates assistant content, while always ignoring user_message_chunk drops the restored prompts. session/resume does not necessarily replay and must retain the local transcript.
resolution: Enter replay mode immediately before session/load, clear the local transcript, accept user chunks only during that replay, and leave persisted history intact for session/resume. Clear history when resume/load falls back to a fresh session.

title: Populate agent commands and skills from ACP session updates
body: ACP runtimes can publish their slash commands and skills through available_commands_update. Pi exposes its skills this way, so a shared client does not need agent-specific skill registries.
resolution: Subscribe per session, rebuild the command palette from the latest availableCommands payload, and insert the selected slash command into the composer so the user can supply any required arguments before sending.

title: Route agent capabilities through AgentControls, never branch on agent id in the UI
body: The UI speaks Powerhouse concepts (cycle mode, change model/reasoning) and src/lib/agentControls.ts resolves them against whatever the agent advertises: ACP `modes` first, then config options categorized as mode/model/thought_level, else a typed {supported:false, reason} result. Keeping resolution pure makes it unit-testable without a live agent.
resolution: Add cycle/select behaviour to agentControls.ts (pure) and call applyOp from useAcpSession; unsupported paths surface next.reason as a system message. No `if agent === "claude"` in components.

title: Native CLI is a non-destructive companion in the bottom panel, not an ACP replacement
body: "Open native CLI" must keep the ACP process, transcript, and draft alive. It opens the persistent bottom panel's AGENT CLI tab (openBottomPanel('agent')) which spawns the active chat's agent command in the same worktree via the out-of-React terminalRegistry, so it survives panel toggles and chat switches. Handoff is modeled as unsupported|workspace-only|resumable (resolveHandoff); default workspace-only and label it a separate conversation — never claim shared session until round-trip resume is verified per runtime.
resolution: BottomPanel renders shell + agentcli-<branchId> terminals per branch; deleteBranch disposes both. Do NOT dispose ACP or flip chat.transport to pty when opening the CLI (the old switchToTerminal behaviour was removed).

title: Image attachments: persist refs only, feed all sources through one gate
body: The whole app tree (including ACP transcripts) is written to one JSON store on every change, so base64 image payloads must never live on transcript items. Tauri intercepts OS file drops (HTML5 drop events carry no paths), and the agent's promptCapabilities.image decides whether images may be sent at all.
resolution: src/lib/attachments.ts keeps a runtime-only id->base64 cache and persists {id,name,mimeType,bytes} refs; usePromptAttachments funnels paste (Files), webview onDragDropEvent (paths via read_image_file), and the dialog picker through the same validation + capability gate. Replayed user image chunks re-register into the cache. Agent prose renders via react-markdown + remark-gfm (AcpMarkdown, .acp-md styles).
